computer_connect_recovery_instructions:
Restore my OpenTag connection.

Computer: {computerName}.
Computer ID: {computerId}.

Use the existing installation and configuration. Run `opentag doctor --json` and `opentag daemon status --json`, inspect recent logs as needed, and fix the diagnosed connection issue. Use `opentag daemon start` only if the installed service is stopped.

Keep my Agents, settings, and local files. Preserve this Computer and its Agent bindings. Do not create a new Computer.

Only if diagnostics show that new authorization is required, run the following one-time recovery command for this existing Computer:
{command}

Do not run this command if the existing connection can be restored without it. If the authorization has expired and is required, ask me to update these instructions in OpenTag.

Verify actual reconnection; a running service alone is not proof. Confirm that OpenTag is online and briefly report the result. If you cannot verify it, explain what still needs attention.
